authority: Parent /root explicitly adopted this scientific triage rule during this review; canonical repository contracts remain unchanged.
rule: An exact author-reported predictive, decoding, encoding or methodological endpoint can be the benchmark primary scored task even when secondary in the article. Preserve the original task rather than requiring the complete headline biological finding family.
versioning: An explicit new scope version, not a claim the old primary had already been satisfied. Preserve old scope decisions and evidence; keep broader biological reproduction separately named.

paper_data.available: Original paper, complete selected-task data in the same declared representation, task contract and explicitly common artifacts.
paper_data.excluded: Official method implementation and algorithm-bearing author-derived solutions unless an explicitly named common artifact already forms part of both conditions.
paper_data.scope: Record the exact preparation and any pretrained weights/common tools supplied; do not call an assisted condition paper-only.

paper_data_author_code.available: Exactly the same paper/data/common artifacts plus the source-pinned official author implementation for this endpoint.
paper_data_author_code.comparison: Same target population, information available to candidate, evaluation split, metric and declared resource accounting; author code is the intended access difference.

reproduction: Recreate the author-reported selected endpoint under the original data/protocol and a justified numerical or uncertainty comparison. A matching unrelated scalar is not reproduction.
improvement: Exceed the strongest relevant author comparator on this same endpoint with the original metric and complete support. Preserve required conditions and companion outputs; do not silently introduce an easier subset, new split, or selected metric. A paper-relative win alone is not current SOTA.
never_improvement: Maximizing statistical significance or an effect size of a biological finding
Increasing an information estimate by changing estimator bias or unsupported reduction
Replacing a held-out endpoint with in-sample fit
Using a new convenient target, denominator or easier data support without declaring a different task
synthetic_method_rule: A source-reported known-truth simulation benchmark can assess a method where scientifically appropriate, but must be explicitly synthetic; it does not establish understanding of real neural recordings. Preserve empirical validation as a separate scope.
proposal_readiness: Selecting an exact original endpoint is scientific scope construction, not admission of authentic execution, improvement_ready, a paper win or submission readiness. Missing roster, split, baseline, runtime or result provenance remains unresolved; no fake pins or results.
